$description:
Overlay contract — the FLOATING elevated surface (menus, popovers, select
popups, tooltips, dialogs, toasts, drawers).

Lean by design (see the taxonomy spec): semantics carry the default look — the
recipe reads --a63-surface-overlay (bg), --a63-border-subtle (border),
--radius-lg (radius), --z-layer-popover (stacking), --a63-control-feedback-*
(entrance) at the use-site. The ONE thing themes vary distinctly for a floating
surface is its ELEVATION, so that is the only contract token here.

--a63-overlay-shadow is a drop/elevation (mode-independent), so it's safe to
default at :root and let each theme override it on its shell (modern soft,
aqua glassy halo, retro hard Win98 offset, terminal phosphor glow).

The contract now carries the full treatment vocabulary plus a drag-shadow
(elevation while a floating surface is dragged).

--a63-overlay-radius intentionally unset at :root; recipes read
   var(--a63-overlay-radius, <own default>) so themes can square all overlays.

$extensions.io.atom63.derive: 0 8px 24px -6px color-mix(in oklch, black 22%, transparent), 0 2px 6px -2px color-mix(in oklch, black 12%, transparent)

shadow.$description:
Elevation while a floating surface is dragged (widgets, window frames).
   Defaults to the resting shadow; a theme/consumer lifts it during drag.

`0 0 #0000` not `none`: composed into comma-separated box-shadow lists
   (`var(--a63-overlay-inner-shadow), var(--a63-overlay-shadow)`). `none` is
   only legal as the sole value, so it invalidates the whole declaration and
   silently drops the overlay's elevation.
